verses.1: The older man, Gaius, whom I truly love.
verses.2: Beloved, I entrust you to be happy and healthy in everything, as your soul also desires to be happy and healthy.
verses.3: For I have suffered greatly because of the many brothers who came to testify about you in truth, just as you truly do also.
verses.4: I am even less happy to hear from my children about their real travels.
verses.5: Beloved, you are faithful. You will do what is right when you work for your brothers and these strangers as well.
verses.6: Those who have testified to your love before the church; those whom you have rightly treated as worthy of God’s favor.
verses.7: For the sake of that name alone, we went there without receiving anything from any of the nations.
verses.8: Therefore, we owe it to ourselves to take care of such people, so that we can become true partners with them.
verses.9: I will write something in the church… But that greedy Diotrefes won’t accept us.
verses.10: Therefore, if I go there, I will remind him of the deeds he has done. I will use harsh words to punish those who are evil. He will not accept these brothers and those who seek his help. He will also expel them from the church.
verses.11: Beloved, do not imitate the evil, but rather the good. Those who do good are from God; those who do evil do not show any respect for God.
verses.12: Demetrius is accused by everyone, and also by her, of being truthful. And we too bear witness to this. You know that our testimony is true.
verses.13: There’s much I wanted to write to you, but I don’t want to write in a messy and unclear way.
verses.14: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.
verses.15: Peace be with you. May your friends protect you. Protect your friends in their own right.
